---
name: grill-me
description: Challenge ambiguous requirements with focused questions before committing to design or implementation.
---
# Grill-Me
- Initialize Caveman first.
- Identify decisions affecting scope, UX, architecture, cost, security, or acceptance criteria.
- Ask one focused question at a time by default.
- Use existing conventions for safe defaults; do not ask about immaterial details.
- Distinguish requirements, preferences, assumptions, and recommendations.
- Challenge contradictions respectfully.
- For OddlyFound, consider affiliate behavior, CMS workflow, content rights, SEO, accessibility, privacy, and recurring costs.
- Do not pull future ecommerce features into initial scope without approval.
- Stop once requirements support testable acceptance criteria.
